event.note: Performed Hajj in the season of 893 AH.
Visited the Haramayn during his pilgrimage.

state.label: شيخ هوار
Shaykh Hawwār
state.note: 初版は「شيخ هوار」を laqab としていたが部族首長職＝state/office に是正し、既登録 TMP-O-00095（شيخ عرب | شيخ العرب）に集約。

event.desc: Generously bestowed alms upon the poor of the Haramayn (Mecca and Medina) and others.

person.note: ダーウード・ビン・イーサー・ビン・ウマル。ハウワーラ部族のシャイフ（長老）。893年の巡礼シーズン（ハッジ）に巡礼を行い、両聖地（マッカとマディーナ）の貧民などに施しを行った者の一人。

Dāwūd ibn ʿĪsā ibn ʿUmar, the shaykh of the Hawwārah tribe. He was among those who performed the Hajj in the season of the year 893 AH, and he acted generously towards the poor of the Two Holy Sanctuaries (Mecca and Medina) and others.
